## History

Skinner was previously married to a man named Crowe before later marrying [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md), choosing love over a wealthier suitor. While working as the local mail carrier, she picked up [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road) station and drove her to her boarding house, [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside). During the journey, Skinner recounted the story of her marriage and concluded the trip by warning [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about the local marsh.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P0](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0000), [v3 ch.Romance P3](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0003), [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013), [v3 ch.Romance P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015)_
